direction.comments: The direction on a macro and micro scale is pretty generic for the genre and literally feels like a 'Nobody' dupe; The action sequences are very over-the-top but still entertaining; The storytelling is pretty messy and also just feels like a 'Nobody' and 'John Wick' dupe; Tension is built through its action sequences, which are pretty good

performance.comments: tries his best to hold together a bad script as he's basically playing his Nobody character again
He's basically an extended cameo in this movie
She's basically an extended cameo in this movie

cast.comments: filled with a bunch of random bad actors, but it's fine cause most of them are just for action purposes; there's like no chemistry at all in this cast, and that kinda stems from bad character writing cause they don't give the characters anything they can be relatable on

story.comments: The concept is kind of a mess because the movie tries to force this Yakuza storyline onto this small town in a pretty bad way, and the sheriff being in the middle of all this feels forced; Also, this movie just feels like an off-brand 'Nobody' but more of a noir; The plot structure is kind of a mess because the exposition does not do a good job of explaining the plot, and the ending is just poorly executed and does not make any sense from a logical perspective; The character writing is not good because you genuinely do not care for any of these characters as their backstories and motivations are not written well

screenplay.comments: The dialogue is very unnatural and forced; The humor is forced and has a pretty low hit rate; The movie does subvert your expectations, but it also just makes the movie feel unnatural in its story construction

score.comments: It establishes the tone and tension

cinematography.comments: It is pretty good as it builds the world and helps show the action sequences

editing.comments: It helps make the movie feel like a noir and helps put together the action sequences

sound.comments: It helps paint the action sequences, though it feels a bit over the top

visual_effects.comments: It is a little over the top, but it does work to help make the movie entertaining

production_design.comments: It helps set this movie in a small town during the winter in Minnesota

review.pacing: The pacing is slow mainly because the movie just is not good
review.climax: The climax is very weird and unnatural, but the final fight sequence is entertaining
review.tone: The tone tries to be a noir dupe of 'Nobody' and 'John Wick'
review.final_notes: I saw the premiere at SXSW
review.overall: Overall, 'Normal' just feels like a bad 'Nobody' dupe as they basically try to make the same movie again but just make it a messy noir; Despite Bob Odenkirk trying his hardest to save this movie and the action sequences being somewhat enjoyable, 'Normal' is just a little too normal in the end, which ultimately makes it pretty forgettable
